tasks.head: e5e7f46
tasks.title: orgs: credential-free Organizations security reference modules + evidence (draft)
tasks.why: It repeats the defect PR #3 flagged in PR #1: infra/orgs/lib/org-cloudtrail-stack.ts:50 sets serverAccessLogsPrefix 'self-access-logs/' on TrailAccessLogsBucket with no destination, so the bucket logs to itself. evidence/shared cfn-s3-selflog reports ERROR TrailAccessLogsBucket30C0D746 on evidence/orgs/synth/BankItLabOrgCloudTrail.template.json. evidence/orgs/SHA256SUMS covers infra/orgs, so a fix has to regenerate the evidence. Otherwise tsc, 49/49 Jest, synth, SHA256SUMS and the synth drift check were clean when trial-merged. The PR is also an explicit draft with no review.
required_changes: Remove the self-logging the same way PR #5 did (terminal sink + documented S1 suppression or exception, plus a test asserting no LoggingConfiguration)
Optionally add an infra/orgs CI workflow modelled on aws-cdk.yml
